title: Ice Age block/Preconstructed theme decks
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Ice Age block theme decks)

paragraphs.text: Ice Age block , comprising Ice Age , Alliances , and Coldsnap , has four theme decks , three of which are bicolored and one is tricolored.

Coldsnap , released years after Ice Age and printed with comparably modern card frames, featured cards from Ice Age and Alliances . Such cards featured in the Coldsnap theme decks were reprinted in modern frames, with symbols indicating rarity and collector numbers, unlike the original cards.
